name: Ramiah
title: Israelite who divorced his foreign wife
summary: Ramiah was one of the Israelites from the family of Parosh who had taken a foreign wife after the exile. In connection with Ezra's reforms, he committed to divorcing his non-Jewish wife to maintain the people's purity and faithfulness to God.

keyEvents.title: Listed among those with foreign wives
keyEvents.description: Ramiah is mentioned among the sons of Parosh who had taken foreign wives and committed to sending them away.

keyEvents.title: Ezra's reform against mixed marriages
keyEvents.description: Ezra led a major reform in Jerusalem where Israelites who had married foreign women were called to divorce them to preserve the covenant with God.

keyEvents.title: The people gather in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: All men of Judah and Benjamin were gathered in Jerusalem within three days to address the matter of the foreign wives.

keyEvents.title: Investigation committee is established
keyEvents.description: A commission was set up to investigate all cases of mixed marriages, and the work was completed over three months.
